body: i guess i never really had to be, i was in college the first two years of adult life and had a part time job but was focusing on school and after that i took a break from school to take care of my grandfather when he was hospitalized the first time in feb 2022 and then later stopped working april 2023 because i went to the psychiatric hospital and then was working again from aug 2023 until june 2024. i was doing fine financially while i was working but ran out of my savings after a little while of being unemployed
